descriptions: You can download a trial version of this app to try it for 30 minutes for free.
You won’t be charged anything when this free trial ends. You can’t make in-app purchases or use add-on content during this free trial, but you’ll keep any achievements you earn.

display_long_description:
# Race. Climb. Fly.

**Vertigo Rush** is a high-speed VR racing game where **your hands are your engine**. Climb, swing, launch yourself through the air and master a polished hand-based movement system built to feel responsive, precise and satisfying.

Race across **visually stunning, highly detailed tracks** filled with vertical challenges, shortcuts, jumps and hazards. Every map has been carefully designed to reward skill, exploration and route mastery.

## Available in Early Access

- **Single-player races** against AI opponents.
- **Time Trial** mode with **global leaderboards**.
- **Online races with friends for up to 10 players**.
- Multiple handcrafted tracks with strong visual variety and detailed environments.
- A refined movement system designed specifically for VR.

This is an **Early Access** release. The game is still growing, and player feedback will help shape its development.

## Coming in the Full Version

- A complete **Story Mode** following Jack and Sarah through the Vertigo Rush championship.
- More tracks and racing environments.
- New gameplay features, content and improvements based on community feedback.

**Easy to learn, challenging to master.** Find the fastest routes, refine every movement and fight for every second.
